answer: Sybil clones cheaply swamp attestations. Put each newcomer on a ledge: lock 12 POA for 48h before any attestation counts; each extra identity multiplies the lock by 1.8x. Peers keep a crystal hash of the attestation graph hourly and reject branches whose edge density jumps over 35% without matching lock growth. A comet probe randomly challenges 4% of new edges with a timed puzzle; failure burns half the lock and freezes the edge for one epoch. Cost is capital and wait. Verification uses public locks plus graph hashes. If probe fails exceed 20%, double the lock multiplier next epoch.
